# RAVENCI Solutions

> Premium web development and digital design agency in Brisbane, Australia.

RAVENCI Solutions is a founder-led digital agency based in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. Founded by Richard Haddad, the studio has 25+ years of experience building high-performance websites, web applications, and brand identity systems for Australian businesses.

## Services

- Website Design & Development (WordPress, Next.js) from $7,500
- eCommerce (Shopify, BigCommerce) from $12,000
- Web Apps & Client Portals from $35,000
- Branding & Brand Identity from $3,500
- SEO & Content from $1,750/mo
- Care Plans (hosting, maintenance, monthly hours) from $249/mo
- Managed Cloud Hosting from $39/mo
